rows.backtranslation: Pixels remain at the top left. If you reduce the canvas size, pixels beyond the right edge or the bottom edge are removed. Undo restores them.
rows.context_and_review_note: Revised yir to yiri, preserving the final vowel of the reviewed iri edge noun in its attached state. Removed the unnecessary llanin relative-existence form, leaving pixels outside the right/bottom edge as a direct location phrase. Retained aflla toward the left as top-left anchoring and the exact existing quoted Undo label. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:1016 selects this help only for nonfresh stretch=false sizing. PaintDocument.kt:423–431 copies the bitmap at 0,0 without resampling, clips beyond reduced right/bottom dimensions and calls replace(next,true). replace captures a checkpoint before switching the bitmap (:202); undo/moveHistory :230–244 restores the prior raster. The text describes this ordinary Undo operation, not indefinite recoverability: history or allocation failures remain possible. It does not promise recovery of overwritten external source files or persistence after every failure.

rows.backtranslation: Enter canvas width greater than 0 and height greater than 0. Neither may exceed 2147483647 (the Android limit).
rows.context_and_review_note: Retained the explicit numeric paraphrase: width and height both >0, and neither above 2147483647. PaintDocument.kt:439–441 subtracts coordinates as Long and checks EACH dimension in 1..Int.MAX_VALUE. Equality at the upper bound is allowed; zero and negative dimensions are not. The feminine tili/yat construction refers to either width or height. The numeric detail is an intentional exact-current-code expansion of Android coordinate range, not a RAM capacity or a guarantee that such an image can be allocated: allocationGuard follows at :443 and is stricter. This hard-coded number must be rechecked if the underlying coordinate range changes. No source dimensions, byte limit or formatting placeholder is invented.
